reason: Complete One Two Sun Dawn sequential mandatory fire destruction, Balcadius full evolution/sweep/spell lock and both souls, Destronlee conditional lone power/breaker, Vaz Romanov dark grave evolution and non-evolution destruction.
validationNotes: Actual nameKey counts9362/9366; clean baseline644bebcb and no running prior work. All9362 existing definitions/IDs/details/catalogue/name aliases/images/pins unchanged; no save-format change.

Four full official cards,11 original/reprint faces and images, current mana and limits verified. Balcadius retains H/E souls confirmed on all3 actual images; Destronlee exact name has a space, other similarly named Demon Dragon Kings excluded. Seven same-name reprints add no names and resolve with their saved name to the original battle ID.

Dawn pays5 or uses optional free S Trigger and resolves mandatory opposing current-power thresholds1000/2000/3000 in order. Missing an early target does not stop later destruction. Balcadius Angel-or-Demon evolution costs10, preserves its base, destroys every other own/enemy creature under exact QA36187, leaves gears, has T and restricts only enemy spells including shield spells while live.

Destronlee full dark Command evolution costs8, native other-creature sweep and lone-own-creature +5000/T continuously track own actual creatures; noncreature gears and opponent creatures do not count. Ignoring source removes its abilities. Vaz Romanov costs7, exactly one own dark grave creature, native evolution stack/W and mandatory opposing non-evolution destruction; encrypted pending base/target survives both players and conserves physical IDs.

Exact QA39123 exposed a real shared bug: Gyai replaced a grave-evolution creature entry but left its selected base in grave. Galaxy replacement now carries the selected g31 or legacy grave stack under Gyai or existing Zoro creature replacement, records base origins, and preserves same-zone semantics. Card replacements such as Tokoshie remain independent and do not consume bases when a hand entry is not replaced. Actual Alpha, multi-choice JSON continuation, legacy DOOM ordinary Gyai entry and multi-base Zoro replacement verified.
